response.sql: WITH scan_data AS (SELECT si.healtheval, s.scancount, CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin ELSE NULL END AS gb_per_minute FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), status_stats AS (SELECT healtheval, SUM(scancount) as total_scancount, AVG(gb_per_minute) as avg_gb_per_minute FROM scan_data GROUP BY healtheval), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) as overall_mean FROM status_stats WHERE avg_gb_per_minute IS NOT NULL) SELECT ss.healtheval, ss.total_scancount, ss.avg_gb_per_minute, ss.avg_gb_per_minute - mc.overall_mean as gap_from_mean FROM status_stats ss CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc WHERE mc.overall_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ss.healtheval;

assumptions.assumption: The chronotag field contains full ISO 8601 timestamps despite the schema indicating text(6); text comparison of these timestamps works correctly for the supplied date range.
